headline_claim.claim: the method caught its own conductor eleven times
headline_claim.basis: No artifact enumerates eleven conductor-catches. The available artifact counts are aggregates with different inclusion rules.

broad_recorded_errors.reason: Includes self-audits and direct human corrections, not only mechanisms that caught the conductor.

correction_headings.reason: Headings are sections, not events; at least one correction heading was itself corrected, so headings can double-count.

pane_agent_triggered.reason: The audit explicitly credits #19 (ask-the-pane) although it was an unwritten habit, not a shipped rule. Twelve is defensible only as the broader actor-triggered count, not as method catches.

adjudication.replacement: The headline must be removed. The strongest supported wording is: mechanisms caught conductor errors on record twelve times across recurring defect families, while the narrower shipped-rule count is eleven after excluding the unwritten ask-the-pane habit; neither number means eleven distinct errors.

families.name: over-kill_on_first_reason
families.assessment: real; B1, demo-6, and incumbent/novelty decisions share the same stop-after-first-plausible-reason mechanism

families.name: citing_without_opening_the_control
families.assessment: real mechanism, but the receipt does not provide a case-key table proving five independent catches; treat five as a qualified recurrence count, not five distinct errors

families.name: adjacent_things_called_identical
families.assessment: real; convergence headline and B1 are distinct episodes of the same judgment failure, but B1 also appears in the over-kill family, so family totals overlap

recurrence_families.coverage_ruling: The phrase 'three families cover 10 of 22' is a set-cover statement, not a disjoint enumeration. The families are not merely adjacent labels, but the artifact must not present 10 as ten unique catches. Citing-without-opening-control is a valid modal failure family and remains live; its five count is qualified until case-keyed.

misstates_or_overclaims.rule_or_claim: caught its own conductor eleven times
misstates_or_overclaims.reason: Unenumerated and numerically contaminated by the separate eleven-of-fifteen count.
#19 was an unwritten habit; distinguish actor-triggered from rule-mediated.

misstates_or_overclaims.rule_or_claim: the lane validated rungs 1-4 and refused 5
misstates_or_overclaims.reason: Rungs 1-4 have evidence in this lane; rung 5 was not attempted and is untested doctrine, not a tested refusal gate.
No record shows anyone conflated resolving a hold with raising a score; the rule was unnecessary mistake-proofing, not outcome-changing evidence.

rules_that_match_the_record: non-author grading and authorship exclusion fired repeatedly and changed outcomes
pre-registration and falsifiable floors fired; the clause prediction failed below its floor
UNASKABLE is correct only with countable missing evidence and a retry predicate
preview sufficiency is not manifest evidence sufficiency; the C5 addendum is required
dry-queue and stale-file rules were written after real failures, but prescribed fixes must not be called fired until verified
the human-chased-catch lifecycle should graduate a catch into a gate or label it unmechanized diligence

omitted_rule_to_keep.rule: No number, baseline, or cited control is evidence until the cited control is opened and its denominator, generator, and failure condition are inspected.
omitted_rule_to_keep.reason: The failure recurred five times by the audit's qualified count and remains live. It is the most consequential portable rule in the record, not merely a retrospective family label.
omitted_rule_to_keep.required_gate: Every numerical claim receipt must include opened_control_path, control_sha_or_revision, denominator, and the observation that would falsify the claim.

limitations: This audit did not re-enumerate every PLAN.md event into a case-keyed table; therefore corrected counts distinguish broad, actor-triggered, and rule-mediated scopes but do not claim eleven distinct catches.
No claim that the gauntlet is validated beyond the tested mechanisms and rungs recorded here.
